item.title: I Was Smiling Outside, Lost Inside Deep Lyrics | 80s Synth-Pop & Retrowave (Night Drive Music) | MERAKI
item.description:
Smiling outside while everything inside was falling apart.
Sometimes anger isn't anger. Sometimes silence isn't peace. Sometimes the person making everyone else laugh is fighting a battle nobody can see.
But when life reminds you how little time is guaranteed, everything changes.
You start thinking about the people you love. The apologies you owe. The hugs you kept putting off. And the things that actually matter.
This verse from ONE MORE DAY is about finally seeing life differently.
🎧 Full song: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WP0oGucZe6Y
Check on your people. Say what you need to say while you still can. ❤️
#deeplyrics #emotionalsong #lifelessons #onemoreday #shorts

item.title: I Was Living Too Fast�Then I Learned Time Isn�t Free | 80s Synth-Pop & Retrowave (Night Drive Music) | MERAKI
item.description:
“I was living too fast, thinking time was free.”
Then suddenly everything you thought mattered starts looking different.
The money. The arguments. The ego. The things you kept saying you'd fix tomorrow.
ONE MORE DAY is about that moment when you realize time was the most valuable thing you had — and you were spending it like it would never run out.
One more try. One more conversation. One more apology. One more day.
🎧 Watch the complete song: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WP0oGucZe6Y
Don't wait for life to teach you the value of today.
What would YOU change if you could rewind one day?
